[h2]New features[/h2]

Available on the display settings screen for compatible GPUs. When enabled, this improve the controller-to-screen latency.
[*] Video help when setting up controller axis on mode 2 (beginner friendly)

notes.title: AiDroneSim 1.37 : The most customizable FPV Sim Ever
notes.content:
AiDroneSim is now officially the most customizable FPV sim ever : import your images and 3D meshes in the in-game editor, and even import whole unreal engine maps !


[h1]PNG Import In Editor[/h1]
The custom Logo projector and the simple Custom Logo item now allow direct importing of PNG Files :
Import your Logo, or any PNG image, from the properties of the item : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/0927edfa8363d3b8d41350f10f12a0ef262bb28d.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892636840]For more information, see the guide[/url]


[h1]3D Objects Import[/h1]
Direct import of 3d objects in editor from files. As with user PNGs, the files are saved as a copy, and will automatically be shared when you share a track or scenery including them. This also import the textures when possible.

Supported formats : OBJ and FBX (binary, embedded textures).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/1aef801f694eaac142a9a5b0507c29caf999f56c.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892636840]For more information, see the guide[/url]


[h1]Unreal Engine map import[/h1]

You can now fly any unreal engine map in AiDroneSim. This is an advanced feature, intended for power users. There is, for now, no in-game/steam workshop integrated way to share your map, but you can always send the zipped folder to friends. 

Here how to package your map for AiDroneSim in less than 10 minutes :

[previewyoutube=oMQyT8At_FY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=http://aidronesim.com/misc/metadata.zip]Don't forget to get the JSON metadata file template[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892647571]See the complete guide[/url]


[h1]Other[/h1]
- Some minor fixes.
- Freestyle contest results will be announced soon.

notes.title: 1.35 Update : Community & creators
notes.content:
First: if not already done, check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1608560/view/3288214038338416067]current Open Contest[/url] with $800 prize pool.

[h1]Overview :[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Download[/b] Drones, Tracks & Sceneries directly from the game.
[*] [b]Undo/Redo[/b] (Ctrl+Z) system in the editor
[*] [b]Native objets editing[/b] in editor.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=LG6pHQx499c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]General[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Download Drones, Tracks & Sceneries directly from the game.
[*] Hide/show all active user interface when flying with [H]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated scenic trail map : more space to go around, bigger gaps everywhere, in particular in the forests.
[*] Airplanes on cinematic mountain are now set to go to 70 kmh (from 60kmh)
[/list]
[*][h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] HUD settings are now available while flying, with direct effects.
[*] Improved FPS display.
[*] Tracks and sceneries are now always displayed in order : tracks first then sceneries, each in typographic order.
[/list]
[*][h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cinematic foliage settings now display foliage details up to 1.5x normal distance. Beware of performance issues !
[*] Low and medium foliage settings are now a bit more aggressive to reduce foliage details.
[*] USB controller input : improved performance. Can speed up FPS on some configurations where the CPU was the bottleneck.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with automatic false starts after spawning on some user tracks.
[*] Fixed some leaderboard display issues in the main menu.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could cause crashes when spawning ghost quads while quitting the level.
[*] Fixed compatibility issues with [url=https://github.com/mikeneiderhauser/CRSFJoystick]CRSF Joystick[/url] . Thanks Felix.
[*] More sensitive axis detection on MacOS, fixing some controllers issues. ( flysky fs-i6x). Thanks Mark.
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Undo/Redo System[/b]. ( Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y)
[*] [b]Editable Natives items[/b] : except for most trees, most native items on the map are now user editable. Delete, duplicate, move or resize any native item.
  Warning : With great power comes great responsibilities, natives items are often way less plug & play than the items available in the left panel. Don't forget to use Undo for any issue.
[*] [b]Groups[/b] :
  Group/ungroup selected items (CTRL+G, ALT+G).
  Grouped items will "stay together" even when not selected.
  Re-selecting an item later will select the whole group.
[*][b]Mass Selection[/b]
Double Click on an item to select all similar items currently in view.
[/list]
[h2]Quality Of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ctrl+S[/b] to save current track.
[*] [b]Contextual Menu[/b] : right click on an item for easy access to common actions, such as group/ungroup.
[*] [b]SAVE & Fly[/b] from the editor, then BACK TO EDITOR for quick fight testing without going back to the main menu. (F2). The undo stack will still be available after flight-testing the map.
[*] FPS HUD are now available in the editor. While it does not map 1:1 to in-flight game performance, it's still an easy way to get an idea about performance.
[*] Camera Position & Speed are now saved in editor, for each track. Useful when alternating between editor mode and fly mode.
[*] Shortcuts are now displayed on most tooltips in the track editor.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Editor UI : Left & Right panel are now resizable.
[*] Search box for the left panel.
[*] Huge performance improvements when flying on sceneries with huge amounts of objects (hi, Kéhops FPV !).
[*] In-Editor performance improvements on such sceneries.
[*] Faster saving time.
[*] Removed central control point on gizmo.
[/list]
[h3]Goodies[/h3]
[list]
[*]A few new items are available. Check the smoke & fires to have some fun.
[/list]


[h1]More[/h1]
[list]
[*] For any issue, feature request or help, join the discord : [url=https://discord.gg/nyebM2t7DF]https://discord.gg/nyebM2t7DF[/url]
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Race Line[/h3]
[b]NEW : Race Line[/b]. Find your way easily in each track thanks to this new race line !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/5be1d356c1aa1de39de2e7882203a3756a13014a.gif[/img]

There is an option to enable or not the race line in user preferences.

[h3]Editor[/h3]

[*] [b]Multiple objects selection[/b].
Use control-left mouse click to add an object to current selection. Then one can move, rotate, duplicate or resize multiple objects at once.

The race line is auto-generated once you have enough gates. Want to manually move it ? simple, click on it, and then move/rotate the control point created :

[*] [b]Brightness[/b] is now replacing gamma, in Display options.
[*] Do you like to make cinematic shots ? Enable [b]motion blur[/b] in the display settings.
[*] Anti-aliasing choice : TAA is better but sometimes a bit blurry, FXAA is sharper but sometimes very bad on grass and foliage. Default is TAA.
[/list]

[h3]Thanks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jay_co for wanting the Race Line so bad.
[*] Method FPV & ZAPPA for editor testing and ideas. And awesome maps !
[*] Everyone else helping to make this sim the best we can !

notes.title: 1.14 : New Base Models
notes.content:
[h3]New Models[/h3]
Everyone likes whoops, at least when the weather is terrible. Most Whoops Flights Controllers don't have integrated memory for blackbox, so there was a lack of whoops models, even in the Workshop.

Therefore we got some whoops, soldered OpenLager cards on them, and flew them hard to get good blackbox data.

The result is two new whoop models in the presets :
[list]
[*] CineWhoop : [b]Beta95X v3 HD[/b]. (without external camera)
[*] 2S whoop : [b]TinyHawk II Micro[/b].
[/list]

In the future we will try to blackbox more whoops (racing ones...), but for the time being we hope these models will produce a good base for further modifications in order to get to your desired whoop model.

[h3]Tip[/h3]
Some big maps are also good for Whoops, like the Truck Factory.

[h3]Misc[/h3]
Spanish Translation by Uriel Alonso Molina Ramírez.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/8e1162aaf30f0fb213b552fe647c75e7a254a64e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/a8ce6067900b54534b32989abb8c1d2597b05002.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]More items[/b]
Check the new [b]Tower Crane[/b] for some quick, good fun.
[*] [b]Items with scalable textures[/b]
Items in "Ground" and "Wall" categories have scalable texture. Size them to 1000% and it should not be too ugly.
It's faster and way better for performance when making buildings, etc.
[*] [b]Tip[/b] :  it's fine to have objects colliding and obstructing each other... but superimposed planes are really bad for performance, and cause flicker. Try to minimize these when possible.
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grass got removed on Medieval Castle. There was too much flickering, and the grass was ugly from afar top-down. We will probably add a better looking but still performant grass in the future.
[*] Gamma are now constrained to reasonable values.
[*] [b]Tip[/b] : do not forget to take a screenshot (click the photo button in top-left panel) before sharing a track or scenery. It will appear on Steam Workshop.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes for known issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Black screen when launching a map ?[/b]
It's because of Gamma in the Display settings. Set it to 1.
If you still have strange display issues, start from scratch by deleting all the files in :
[i]C:\Users\USER_NAME\AppData\Local\RealFPV_proto2\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor[/i]

[*] [b]My BetaFPV radio worked three weeks ago but not now ?[/b]
You need to redo the radio setup one time.
Do the same as first time, e.g by clicking on [i]Generic USB controller Axis 3[/i] to re-assign axis :
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qvGfgPln8BU]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qvGfgPln8BU[/url]

[*] [b]DJI FPV Remote Controller not working ?[/b]
First, activate it :
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oCsj9oDh8L8]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oCsj9oDh8L8[/url]
Then do the game setup :
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qvGfgPln8BU]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qvGfgPln8BU[/url]
[/list]

[h3]Help or Contact[/h3]
Feel free to contact us :
[list]
[*] Mail : diophante.studio at gmail.com
[*] Discord Server: https://discord.gg/FNekmBXeAP
[/list]

notes.title: 1.10 : Steam Workshop
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Workshop[/h2]

[h3]Downloading from Steam Workshop[/h3]
[list]
[*] Go to the Steam Workshop page and subscribe to items to get them in the game.
[/list]
[h3]Models[/h3]
[list]
[*] Delete, duplicate, and share models by [b]right-clicking the Model name[/b] in the selection list
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/1a92249d0419f5cfbb01f8b172c3bb86a53be3bc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/1170a2da1241b5ddc4a5172c0bad482fea71c0df.png[/img][/url]
[/list]
[h3]Tracks[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the Track Editor :
[*] [b]Save As..[/b] duplicate a track, creating a new one from the old one.
[*] Click the [b]SHARE button[/b] to share your track on Steam Workshop.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/5eaad6fe9bb0feec4ec216fa21c934bc4466779c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/cb8dc623c038dd7d8ecba3d693430cae830e8321.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Tip[/b] : you can share a track with 0 gates but only decor (and a start) for freestyle fun.
[/list]
[h2]Display[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]! Change ![/b] : [b]Resolution, Monitor, Max FPS, and Vsync[/b] still auto-apply but no longer auto-save. If you bug (display or mouse) after modifying a setting, press CANCEL or ESCAPE to go back. If you like the new value, [b]you now need to click SAVE to keep it[/b].
[*] [b]New[/b] : Monitor selection in video settings. Don't forget to SAVE to keep it for the next launch.
[*] Gamma has way more effect on the FPV camera now. Change gamma to get the camera brighter or darker

[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switches Axis now displayed correctly in loading tips.
[*] Misc. other small things.
[/list]

Do you want to use a Radio Controller Switch to [Respawn] ? Does it not work for you ?

[*] For OpenTX radio controllers, channels 1-8 are USB Axis, channels 9-32 are sent as buttons.
[*] Modify or make a "simulator" Model on your Taranis.
[*] Tip : save battery by setting no internal or external output on the simulator model.
[*] Set your Switch to output 9 or more :
[previewyoutube=EroAvVTfdYk;full][/previewyoutube]
[/olist]

notes.title: Update to 0.91
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.91[/h2]

[h3][b]New[/b] : PIDs loop controls[/h3]
The game uses a unified model of rotation control and rotation physics. Each model has its values determined from the original BlackBox file.
But each pilot should have total control, so we introduced the [b]PID Authority[/b] and [b]PID Responsivity[/b] parameters :
[list]
[*] Increase [b]PID Authority[/b] to [b]kill the rebound[/b] after a flip. 
[*] Increase [b]PID Responsivity[/b] to have a [b]more responsive[/b] quad. (like more P)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/e95ccce3ae44e8e943a13ec1d09ba9941d2efd28.png[/img]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Field Of View shortcuts controls. By default, press the keyboard RIGHT key to increase the FOV, the LEFT key to decrease it.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed : track items not appearing after entering multiple times the Track Editor.
[*] Fixed : FrSky XSR-SIM compatibility. Now works fine.
[/list]

tags.feature: The game uses a unified model of rotation control and rotation physics.
Added Field Of View shortcuts controls.
